reviewer: Claude coordinator and independent Claude review agents (text, illustrations)
text: Independent review agent read the full text against Ryder's Mother Shandilee's Bargain with the ending from Self-defeating Forethought; the ending is faithful and the outcome is left open, as in the source.
The Brahman host, the Shandili gotra name and the frame (Wide-Bottom, Crop-Ear and the mouse Gold) are dropped or anonymised, and every change is disclosed.
Age band 8+: deceit but no harm. The dog fouling the sesame is kept in one plain everyday sentence because the plot depends on it.

The pause question comes before the neighbour's husband explains the catch. After review a gesture now matches the picture and the neighbour's wife is called ಮನೆಯೊಡತಿ to avoid confusion. No em dashes.
illustrations: Storyboard 1024x1536, 440 KB, on the 512 px grid, painted to every edge with no text. Panel 6 is composited from one edit pass (the husband now points doubtfully out of the door instead of angrily at his wife) with a clean seam; the other panels are untouched.
No urination or puddle is drawn; the dog is only shown walking away.
The characters, dish, basket and pot are consistent; similar skin tones, barefoot, no caste markers.
limitations: AI-agent editorial review, not human Kannada-teacher or scholar certification.
Age bands are editorial judgements against the README table and have not been tested with children, parents or adult readers.
Source fidelity was checked against saved copies of the Wikisource pages of Ryder's 1925 translation, not against Durgasimha's Kannada text or a Sanskrit recension.
Art was generated with Codex CLI on gpt-5.6-sol and judged on the full sheet and 512px panel crops with the grid measured in pixels, not in the app in dark mode.
